summary: Follow-up frontend-only re-test of Framewright (no backend). Verified all 6 fixes from iteration_4 with concrete DOM measurements (getBoundingClientRect / documentElement.scrollWidth) at 1920px and 390px, plus a light smoke pass on navigation, all 5 pipeline states, content-tab live preview, job history and mock login. All 6 fixes PASS; zero console errors/pageerrors across every run.

issues: Inside the mocked preview iframe (314px wide) the 'Start building' / 'Watch demo' CTA labels wrap and get vertically clipped by the button box. Purely cosmetic inside the mock srcDoc, no page overflow.
Idle state still leaves a fairly tall empty region below 'Telemetry starts here' due to .pipeline min-height:300px; acceptable but could be tightened.

critical_code_review_comments: CodeTab copy() is now safe (guards navigator.clipboard?.writeText and .catch(()=>{})). Consider surfacing a subtle 'Copy failed' hint instead of a fully silent no-op for UX clarity.

Studio.generate() re-entry guard + timerRef cleanup on unmount are correct; note the button re-enables the instant jobState flips to 'done', so a click ~3.4s after start legitimately restarts a run (verified: pipeline still reaches DONE with exactly 7 stage nodes).
test_credentials: Mock auth - any email/password accepted (used qa@example.com / pass1234)

verification_details.FIX1_clipboard: PASS - clicked pipeline-code-copy-button with no clipboard permission granted; 0 #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay nodes, no pageerror/unhandled rejection, page remained interactive (tab switch back to Stages worked).
verification_details.FIX2_fields_grid_1920: PASS - composer panel right=760; page-name-input right=560 (w=169), section-name-input right=739 (w=169). No clipping; document scrollWidth==clientWidth==1920.
verification_details.FIX3_breakpoint_toggle_390: PASS - Mobile/Tablet/Desktop all keep documentElement.scrollWidth=390 (==clientWidth); live-preview-frame-wrap stays 314px wide inside panel.
verification_details.FIX4_stage_timeline_390: PASS - RUNNING: timeline scrollWidth=614 vs clientWidth=316 with overflow-x:auto, document scrollWidth stays 390. DONE (Stages tab) also 390.
verification_details.FIX5_code_tab_390: PASS - <pre> scrollWidth=407 vs clientWidth=316, overflow-x:auto; document scrollWidth stays 390. Full DOM scan found 0 elements exceeding viewport+2px.
verification_details.FIX6_generate_reentry: PASS - after first click button is disabled with text 'Generating…'; rapid re-clicks blocked by Playwright actionability (no concurrent timers). Navigating Home mid-run produced zero console errors/warnings (no setState-on-unmounted warning).
verification_details.smoke: Home<->Studio<->Preview 5 cycles: 0 blank flashes. Dropzone text 'PNG, JPG or WEBP · max 8MB'. Accent disclosure toggles, 6 buttons (5 presets + Reset), value shows #3B82F6. All 5 dev-switcher states render correct pills (IDLE/RUNNING/NEEDS INPUT/DONE/FAILED). Content tab headline edit -> live iframe updated to 'QA Headline 42'. Job history shows 3 items. Login mock -> /generate with user-avatar-button; avatar click logs out back to / with Sign in pill. Landing hero console shows no animated border-trail.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_4 defects are fixed and verified via DOM measurement at 1920px and 390px. Useful testids: composer-panel, page-name-input, section-name-input, generate-button, breakpoint-{mobile|tablet|desktop}-button, live-preview-frame-wrap, live-preview-iframe, stage-timeline, dev-state-{idle|running|needs-input|done|failed}-button, pipeline-tab-{stages|code|content}-button, pipeline-code-tab, pipeline-code-copy-button, content-field-value-textarea, nav-{home|studio|preview}-link, nav-sign-in-button, login-{email-input|password-input|submit-button}, user-avatar-button. Note the Code/Content tabs only exist in DONE state. Untested areas remaining: /preview page depth, mobile drawer nav, tablet 768px layout.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous clipboard bug was an unhandled promise rejection from navigator.clipboard.writeText; now wrapped in .then/.catch with a capability guard. Overflow bugs were caused by missing min-width:0 on grid/flex children which prevented shrinking and pushed page-level scrollWidth; min-width:0 + overflow-x:auto on stage-timeline/pre now contains scrolling internally.
